issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one complete finding-disposition ledger for the accepted-finding denominator.

## Primary deliverable

One finding-disposition ledger binding each accepted finding to a reviewed fix or explicit owned deferral.

## Verification result

The finding census reports every accepted finding exactly once with evidence, owner, disposition, and review identity.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one complete finding-disposition ledger; individual remediations remain separately reviewable evidence.

## Dependencies

- TAIL-05: #521

## Retained predecessor scope

- #188

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every finding has exactly one disposition
- [ ] Every substantive fix has exact-head review
- [ ] Every deferral names owner rationale and target milestone

## Owned paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/release/tail-06/**`

## PVF lanes

- `finding-census`
- `remediation-proof`
- `deferral-truth`

## Stop conditions

- A release-blocking finding remains

## Non-goals

- Silent deferral
- Ceremony

## Canonical planning identity

- Planned ID: `TAIL-06`
